headline: Approved Valentine Group bid to sell 18 South Main Street and ranked facilities projects to be funded from the remaining bond balance.
summary: Members discussed how to meet the newly approved tax cap, which now needs a reduction of about $2.75 million. Four policies were adopted, and the superintendent and assistant superintendent were authorized to issue emergency no-trespass orders.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including October 27, 2026 minutes and a manifest totaling $4,568,234.97, 7-0.
Approved a ranked list of facilities projects to be funded from the remaining bond balance, and directed staff to obtain bids or quotes, 7-0.
Approved the Valentine Group bid to provide brokerage services for the sale of 18 South Main Street, 6 yes and 1 abstention.
Approved policies BEA, JFAA, JHC and JLDBB, 7-0.
Policy BBBA was withdrawn from this round of consideration.
Approved designating the Superintendent, or the Assistant Superintendent in the Superintendent’s absence, to issue emergency no-trespass orders on public property, 7-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Jamie Carreau Moved to accept the Consent Agenda. Jennifer Theroux seconded the Motion. Vote: Yes, Unanimous 7-0

Jennifer Theroux Moved to approve the list of projects ranked in order of priority, directing the Facilities Department to obtain bids or quotes on these projects with the goal of completing as many as possible until the bond balance is depleted. Jenna Paradise seconded the Motion. Vote: Yes, Unanimous 7-0
Jamie Carreau Moved to accept the bid from Valentine Group. Jenna Paradise seconded the Motion. Vote: Yes, 6 Abstain, 1
Jenna Paradise Moved to approve the policies as presented. Jamie Carreau seconded the Motion. Vote: Yes, Unanimous 7-0
Policy BBBA was withdrawn from this round of consideration.

Jenna Paradise Moved that pursuant to RSA 635:2-a, the Derry Cooperative School Board designate the Superintendent of Schools, or the Assistant Superintendent of Schools in the Superintendent’s absence, to issue emergency no-trespass orders concerning public property... This designation remaining effective until modified or rescinded by the Board. Vote: Yes, Unanimous 7-0
